Description of Event:
Orientation will consist of a short overview of three projects. After the overview students will be given a preprinted Electrical Circuit that they will breadboard after identifying the values of the parts needed to achieve a required Resistance value. Students will be scored based on the required resistance value within standard resistor tolerance values. 
Judges will provide the circuit and the parts required.  Students will provide breadboard and jumpers, possibly a calculator, and a multimeter.
Example Competition Materials: - Breadboard, Jumpers, Calculator, Multimeter, Circuits Knowledge

The student team will present its innovative idea along with a design board, a design prototype and engineering notebook.
